variants.name: detach every incident direction and kind count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'out'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}), (m:DeleteNode {name:'out'}) DETACH DELETE n, m RETURN count(*) AS c
UNWIND [1,2,3] AS x MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: explicit incident relationships across rows count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'})-[r]-() DELETE n, r RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: explicit incident relationships reversed target order count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'})-[r]-() DELETE r, n RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: plain node with null optional relationship count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-() DELETE r, n RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: plain and detached adjacent nodes count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'left'})-[]->(m:DeleteNode {name:'right'}) DELETE n DETACH DELETE m RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH ()-[r:DeleteEdge {name:'outgoing'}]->() DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) WITH n DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n WITH 1 AS x MATCH (m:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) DELETE m RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: plain isolated after WITH pagination count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n ORDER BY n.name SKIP 1 LIMIT 1 DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n ORDER BY n.name LIMIT 0 DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: plain isolated after WITH filter count

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n WHERE n.name='isolated' DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c

MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) DELETE n RETURN 7 AS x
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DELETE n RETURN 7 AS x
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'missing'}) DELETE n RETURN 7 AS x
MATCH ()-[r:DeleteEdge {name:'outgoing'}]->() DELETE r RETURN 7 AS x
MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n ORDER BY n.name LIMIT 0 DELETE n RETURN 7 AS x

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) SET n.touched = true DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c

MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) WITH n, n.name AS name DETACH DELETE n RETURN name
UNWIND [3,1,2] AS x MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN x ORDER BY x SKIP 1 LIMIT 1
UNWIND [1,1,2] AS x MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN DISTINCT x ORDER BY x
UNWIND [1,1,2] AS x MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN x, count(*) AS c ORDER BY x
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) WITH n, n AS m SET m.touched = true DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
CREATE (n:DeleteNode {name:'temporary'}) DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (a:DeleteNode {name:'left'}), (b:DeleteNode {name:'right'}) CREATE (a)-[r:DeleteOtherEdge]->(b) DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) SET n.touched = true DETACH DELETE n WITH 1 AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) SET n.first = true WITH n SET n.touched = true DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}), (m:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) SET m.touched = true DETACH DELETE n RETURN m.name
